headline: Fishermans Row Leads Surge of Base Flips Across Fronts
war_summary: Since the 18:10 edition the western front has remained the most volatile. Fishermans Row still tops the ledger with thirty‑eight ownership changes on the day, the last recorded at 17:25 Z, while Lykos Isle has logged eighteen flips, the newest at 18:52 Z. Dead Lands and Weathered Expanse have each added two flips earlier but show no fresh activity in the last two hours, their latest events stamped at 17:10 Z. Stlican Shelf has picked up three new flips in the past two hours, raising its day total to eight with the most recent at 19:52 Z. Oarbreaker and Tempest Island have both seen a burst of activity — two and three flips respectively in the last two hours — pushing their daily counts to four and nine. Farranac Coast remains quiet after its 04:10 Z flips, holding eleven for the day. Casualty streams are accelerating on several decisive sectors — Linn Mercy, Loch Mor, Marban Hollow, Kings Cage, Stlican Shelf and Oarbreaker — while Clahstra, Callahans Passage, Dead Lands and Weathered Expanse are cooling. The strategic map still favors Colonials on the western and southern arcs and Wardens to the north and east.
